description: Source code for generating TypeScript protocol type definitions for different browsers (Chromium, WebKit, Firefox) within the Playwright project. Contains functions to fetch, parse, and convert protocol JSON data into TypeScript types.

methods.name: generateProtocol
methods.description: Main function to generate protocol types for a given browser name ('chromium', 'firefox', 'webkit') using the specified executable path.

methods.name: generateChromiumProtocol
methods.description: Generates TypeScript definitions for Chromium protocol by launching a Chromium browser, retrieving protocol JSON, and converting it to TypeScript.

methods.name: generateWebKitProtocol
methods.description: Generates TypeScript definitions for WebKit protocol by reading a local protocol JSON file and converting it to TypeScript.

methods.name: jsonToTS
methods.description: Converts protocol JSON data into TypeScript type definitions for Chromium/WebKit.

methods.name: typeOfProperty
methods.description: Determines the TypeScript type string for a given protocol property.

methods.name: generateFirefoxProtocol
methods.description: Generates TypeScript definitions for Firefox protocol by extracting and parsing protocol data from a Firefox omni.ja archive.

methods.name: firefoxJSONToTS
methods.description: Converts Firefox protocol JSON data into TypeScript type definitions.

methods.name: firefoxTypeToString
methods.description: Converts Firefox protocol type objects into TypeScript type strings.
